issue.title: MethodSignatureMismatch in presence of array parameter (when using preloadClasses)

repository.name: psalm
repository.description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

issue.body:
I have an odd situation that I am unable to reproduce using psalm.dev regarding what I believe is a false positive when inheriting a method with list (or array).

The code looks something like this: https://psalm.dev/r/b8d39294ea

Locally, I get the following (although each one is deep in a namespace):

ERROR: MethodSignatureMismatch - DefaultEncoderReconciler.php:31:33 - Argument 1 of DefaultEncoderReconciler::reconcile has wrong type 'array<array-key, mixed>', expecting 'list<Encoder>' as defined by EncoderReconcilerInterface::reconcile

If I widen the param type in the DefaultEncoderReconciler by removing the actual array, the error does not occur. 

This may be related to https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/issues/5126 as it also refers to the array typehint overriding the phpdoc which appears to be what is happening in this case.

Error:
```
  class DefaultEncoderReconciler implements EncoderReconcilerInterface, PublicService { 
       /**
       * @param list<Encoder> $encoders
       */
 	  public function reconcile(array $encoders, bool $foo = false): void { }
  }
```

No Error:
```
  class DefaultEncoderReconciler implements EncoderReconcilerInterface, PublicService { 
       /**
       * @param list<Encoder> $encoders
       */
 	  public function reconcile($encoders, bool $foo = false): void { }
  }
```

After failing to create a reproduction on psalm.dev I started stripping away code and configuration line by line until I discovered what appears to be the trigger;  the presence of preloadClasses="true" in a stub. 

```   
  <stubs>
          <file name="any-stub-file.php" preloadClasses="true" />
      </stubs>
```

Triggers the error. Removing preloadClasses="true" also removes the error.

Version: dev-master@93e9054f98b040bf246c2023201503db3dbf162c

issue.title: Couchbase class aliases in stubs are not recognized

repository.name: psalm
repository.description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

issue.body:
psalm.xml:

```
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<psalm>
	<projectFiles>
		<directory name="." />
		<ignoreFiles>
			<directory name="vendor" />
			<directory name="stubs" />
		</ignoreFiles>
	</projectFiles>
	<stubs>
		<file name="stubs/couchbase/toplevel.php" preloadClasses="true"/>
		<file name="stubs/couchbase/couchbase.php" preloadClasses="true"/>
	</stubs>
</psalm>
```

stub files downloaded from here: https://github.com/JetBrains/phpstorm-stubs/tree/master/couchbase

app.php:

```
<?php

new CouchbaseCluster("foo");
```

Running psalm on this throws "Could not get class storage for couchbasecluster". Changing it to `new Couchbase\Cluster` works fine.

You can reproduce the issue with this Dockerfile:

```
FROM php:7.4

RUN apt update
RUN curl -O http://packages.couchbase.com/releases/couchbase-release/couchbase-release-1.0-8-amd64.deb
RUN apt install -y lsb-release gpg unzip git
RUN dpkg -i couchbase-release-1.0-8-amd64.deb
RUN apt update
RUN apt install -y libcouchbase-dev
RUN pecl install couchbase-2.6.2
RUN echo "extension=couchbase.so" > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/couchbase.ini
RUN mkdir app
WORKDIR /app
RUN php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');"
RUN php composer-setup.php
RUN php -r "unlink('composer-setup.php');"
RUN php composer.phar init -n -s dev  --name=test/test
RUN php composer.phar require --dev psalm/phar
# RUN php composer.phar require --dev psalm/phar:dev-master # dev-master doesn't work either
RUN echo '<?xml version="1.0"?><psalm><projectFiles><directory name="." /><ignoreFiles><directory name="vendor" /><directory name="stubs" /></ignoreFiles></projectFiles><stubs><file name="stubs/couchbase/toplevel.php" preloadClasses="true"/><file name="stubs/couchbase/couchbase.php" preloadClasses="true"/></stubs></psalm>' > psalm.xml
RUN mkdir -p stubs/couchbase
WORKDIR /app/stubs/couchbase
RUN curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JetBrains/phpstorm-stubs/master/couchbase/toplevel.php
RUN curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JetBrains/phpstorm-stubs/master/couchbase/couchbase.php
WORKDIR /app
RUN echo '<?php' > app.php
RUN echo 'new CouchbaseCluster("foo");' >> app.php
# RUN echo 'new Couchbase\Cluster("foo");' >> app.php # this works
RUN cat app.php && php vendor/bin/psalm.phar --debug
```
